resources.string: Choose the host and pair with StrmQt
Forget this device\'s pairing with StrmQt and pair with a new code
The TV remote drives StrmQt. Game controllers and keyboards work as before. Hold Back for 2 seconds for the menu.
Opening the app goes straight to the StrmQt stream, and reconnects if it drops
4K, 30 FPS, HEVC, paced for video. 1080p when this device cannot decode 4K.
Open the stream when the device has booted. Needs a permission granted over adb; see the fork\'s notes.
Bring the stream back when the device wakes. Needs the same permission.
This device cannot decode 4K HEVC. Stream preset applied: 1080p, 30 FPS, HEVC.
Hold Back for 2 seconds to open the menu
Remote: this device was removed in StrmQt. Pair again.
Remote: StrmQt\'s certificate changed. Pair again in Settings.
Remote: not paired with StrmQt. Hold Back, then Settings.
The remote is not paired with StrmQt. Choose Set up StrmQt to pair it.
Choose Set up StrmQt to find StrmQt and pair with it.
The chosen host is no longer in the host list. Choose it again under Set up StrmQt.
This device is not paired with %1$s. Choose Set up StrmQt to pair again.
No StrmQt host answered. Check that StrmQt\'s streaming host is running, or enter its address below.
Searching failed: %1$s. Enter the address below.
Choose Pair. This screen then shows one code to type into StrmQt; it pairs both the stream and the remote.
Type this code into StrmQt under Settings, Web Remote, Pair a StrmLight, or into StrmQt\'s phone remote under Remote, Pair a StrmLight. Typing it once pairs both the stream and the remote.
Choose a host or enter StrmQt\'s address.
The ports must be numbers from 1 to 65535.
Stream: StrmQt\'s Sunshine still has an earlier pairing attempt open. Typing the code into StrmQt clears it; trying again every 5 s.
Stream: StrmQt\'s Sunshine was given a different code. Type the code on this screen into StrmQt again.
Stream: StrmQt\'s Sunshine refused to pair. Trying again in 5 s.
Stream: StrmQt\'s Sunshine does not answer at %1$s:%2$d. Still trying.
Remote: contacting StrmQt\'s Web Remote at %1$s:%2$d…
Remote: StrmQt was given a different code. Type the code on this screen into StrmQt again.
Remote: too many wrong codes were typed in. Asking StrmQt again in %1$d s.
Remote: StrmQt\'s Web Remote does not answer at %1$s:%2$d. Still trying.
StrmQt\'s certificate changed while pairing. Choose Pair to start again.
The Web Remote at %1$s:%2$d does not present the certificate StrmQt announced on the network. Pairing stopped.
This StrmQt cannot pair with StrmLight by code. Update StrmQt, then pair again.
